$comment: Every image slot on the site. Each slot lights up automatically once the file exists at `path` — no code change needed (see src/lib/media.ts). Use the `prompt` verbatim in ChatGPT/Gemini image generation, or drop in a real photograph. Keep `aspect` exact; the site crops with object-fit: cover, so anything off-ratio loses its edges.

brand.look: Antique brass plaque, deep navy inlay, warm cream paper ground. Photographic-realistic relief, soft directional light from the upper left, subtle brushed-metal grain.
brand.photographyDirection: Real working shots, not stock gloss. Warm afternoon light, shallow depth of field, honest textures — jute sacks, brass weighing scales, coiled rope, cotton dust in the light. Nothing staged-looking, no visible faces required, no text baked into the image.
brand.logoNote: Transparent circular PNG, pre-trimmed to the artwork. Regenerate the 512/256/96 sizes and src/app/icon.png + apple-icon.png from the source via the rt-media skill.

slots.usedBy: Home hero — slide 1 visual — FALLBACK ONLY. Live hero slides are published from the RT admin (Store → Content), which uploads to /uploads/hero/. This repo path is used only when no admin slide exists.
slots.prompt: Photograph of a long-established thread and fishing-net wholesale shop front in Patna City, Bihar, India. Rolls of fishing net and stacked cotton yarn cones visible through the open shutter, hand-painted signboard, warm late-afternoon sunlight, weathered concrete and brass. Documentary style, shallow depth of field, no readable text, no people's faces. Portrait 3:4.

slots.usedBy: Home hero — slide 2 visual — FALLBACK ONLY. Live hero slides are published from the RT admin (Store → Content), which uploads to /uploads/hero/. This repo path is used only when no admin slide exists.
slots.prompt: Interior of a well-kept Indian wholesale godown stacked floor to ceiling with cartons of cotton thread cones and rolled fishing netting. Shafts of daylight through a high window, dust in the air, jute sacks, a brass weighing scale in the foreground. Warm, honest, documentary photography. Portrait 3:4, no text, no faces.

slots.usedBy: Home hero — slide 3 visual — FALLBACK ONLY. Live hero slides are published from the RT admin (Store → Content), which uploads to /uploads/hero/. This repo path is used only when no admin slide exists.
slots.prompt: Close documentary photograph of hands hand-tying a fishing net, knots and mesh filling the frame, natural nylon twine in cream and blue, warm side light, shallow depth of field. Craft and precision. Portrait 3:4, no faces, no text.

Overhead photograph of cotton thread cones in rows — cream, red, orange and yellow yarn wound on cones. Even soft daylight, rich texture, tight crop so the cones fill the frame. Landscape 16:9, no text.
Tight photograph of green and cream nylon fishing net mesh, knots clearly visible, gently draped so the diamonds catch the light. Warm daylight, shallow depth of field. Landscape 16:9, no text.
Coiled polypropylene and nylon rope in blue, white and green, stacked coils seen from above, twist and fibre texture sharp. Warm natural light. Landscape 16:9, no text.

Flat-lay of commercial fishing hardware — nickel long-shank hooks in a tray, bright orange HDPE float balls and lead sinkers on weathered wood. Warm directional light, crisp detail. Landscape 16:9, no text.

Workshop bench where netting is made to order — measuring tape, shuttle needle, twine spools and a partly finished net panel. Warm workshop light, honest and tactile. Landscape 16:9, no faces, no text.

Wide documentary photograph of a family-run Indian yarn and net trading shop interior — wooden shelving stacked with cone yarn, a ledger and brass scale on the counter, warm afternoon light from the street. Landscape 4:3, no faces, no readable text.

slots.prompt: Wide banner image: cotton yarn cones and coiled fishing net arranged on a warm cream surface, shot from above with generous empty space in the left third for a logo and title overlay. Soft even light, premium editorial product photography. Landscape 1200x630, no text.

conventions.format: JPEG for photographs, quality 82. PNG only for artwork that needs transparency.
conventions.naming: lowercase-kebab-case, no spaces, no version suffixes
conventions.note: Run the `rt-media` skill after dropping files in — it crops to the exact aspect, resizes, compresses and reports what is still missing.

heroNote: Hero images: upload via the RT admin at Store → Content, one per slide. The repo slots under public/img/hero/ are the offline fallback used only when the admin has no active slides.
campaignNote: Campaign media: upload via the RT admin at Store → Campaigns. Never added to this repo. Briefs live in content/campaigns/.
